description: "Science & Education: Essays" by Thomas Henry Huxley is a collection of essays written in the late 19th century, encompassing various topics related to the philosophy of science and education. The essays illustrate Huxley's views on the importance of empirical science and rational thought in education, emphasizing how they can enhance understanding and engage learners in a meaningful way.
